name: WristWatch G2
description: The WristWatch G2 (WWG2) is a community-designed standalone extruder that uses Galileo 2 internals for filament extrusion. Designed by @bythorsthunder with contributions from tetsu97, it is built as an alternative to the WristWatch BMG extruder. It uses the same 9:1 planetary gear system and dual drive mechanism as the Galileo 2 but features a revised three-part body (main body, rear plate, tension arm) and uses the Orbiter 2.0 mounting pattern.
features: Three-part body design for improved printability
Compatible with XOL2 and other toolheads via adapters
